title: SHOUR HAI YAHI BARPA QATL HOGAYE MOULA
body:
SHOUR HAI YAHI BARPA QATL HOGAYE MOULA
1. Shour Hai Yahi Barpa Qatl Hogaye Moula.
Roorahaa Hai Sab Koofa Qatl Hogaye Moula.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Betiyaan Ye Kahti Hai Yunn Na Jaayiey Baba.
Karrahe Hain Sab Giriyaa Qatl Hogaye Moula.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Saare Shayhere Koofa May Gham Ki Hai Fiza Chaayie.
Har Taraf Hai Yeh Charcha Qatl Hogaye Moula.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Kya Sitam Kiya Moula Tumpe Ibne Mulijim Ne.
Kaanpi Masjid E Koofa Qatl Hogaye Moula.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Koun Ab Qabar Lega Bekason Ki Aye Baba.
Zulm Ye Huwa Kaisa Qatl Hogaye Moula.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Ab Janaza Uthta Hai Ghar Se Mere Moula Ka.
Hashr Sa Hai Ek Barpa Qatl Hoagye Moula.
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Baanttha Tha Raaton Ko Rizq Jo Ghareebon May.
Koun Hai Ab Unn Sab Ka Qatl Hogaye Moula.
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Haaye Shayhere Koofa May Chhagayi Fiza Gham Ki.
Chaar Sou Hai Sannata Qatl Hogaye Moula.
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Zindagi May Ahmed Ko Murtuza Se Dhhaaras Thi.
Do Nabi Ko Sab Pursa Qatl Hogaye Moula.
<<DIVIDER>>
10.Tegh Ibne Muljim Ne Sar Pejab Lagayii Hai.
Tha Lahoo May Sab Chehra Qatl Hogaye Moula.
<<DIVIDER>>
11.Haaye Ahle Koofa May Tha Sohail Ek Mehshar.
Lab Pe Sab Ke Tha Nouha Qatl Hogaye Moula.
AZZ:- RAZA ALI SOHAIL
